WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_count,
    CAST(invoice_count AS REAL) / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share,
    AVG(invoice_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM state_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(invoice_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess
FROM stats
WHERE invoice_count > avg_count
